title: Facial proportions, neoclassical canons and the golden-ratio myth

queue.claim: The Malaysian finding that only 17.1% of facial proportions conformed to the golden ratio, with no link to ratings, comes from 'Multiracial Facial Golden Ratio and Evaluation of Facial Appearance' (PMC4642949)
queue.query: Multiracial facial golden ratio and evaluation of facial appearance 17.1% Malaysian

queue.claim: Moving the upper boundary of the middle third from nasion up to glabella (soft-tissue g is ~10-15 mm above n) makes middle and lower thirds near-equal (~1:1.05), explaining why brow-based artist thirds hold better than Farkas nasion-based thirds
